rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm this rule prevents: a numeral or grouping claim duplicating what the adjacent structure already shows, buying nothing on the way in and going silently stale the moment an item is added, cut, or reordered without the numeral being touched. Two instances found, both pre-existing (outside the pinned diff, which touched only the maintainer Quality-line stamp). (1) Line 39, 'Treat these as your defaults. The first two are about what you let in.', sits directly above exactly two bolded moves (Start clean; Pass paths, not paste); the parallel line 47, 'The rest are about what you do with the work once it's in front of you,' is the softer grouping-adjacent-list form of the same pattern the rule generalises to. Adding or reordering a bolded move under either `## The craft` header silently falsifies 'the first two' / 'the rest' without the sentence itself being edited. (2) Line 73, 'The rest fall into two kinds: durable problems you engineer around, and loud problems whose fix already shipped,' is immediately followed by exactly two named kinds across two headers (the durable ones / the loud ones) -- but a THIRD header, 'Drivers of inefficient context: fanning out is its own bill' (line 87), follows under the same umbrella, describing a cost that is neither durable-you-engineer-around nor loud-but-already-fixed ('Treat it as a ceiling ... not a default for yours', line 89 -- no shipped fix is claimed). This is debatable rather than certain: a prior instance of this same judge class read the identical three headers under §18 and did not flag the count, which may mean 'fanning out' is deliberately meant to sit OUTSIDE the two-kind taxonomy (its own header literally says 'its own bill') rather than being a silently-added third kind. Flagged here as a genuine open question, not a confident defect.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: For (1): drop the count/grouping framing and let the two `## The craft` headers plus their bolded moves carry the split on their own. For (2): either revise line 73 to acknowledge a third, orthogonal cost axis ('The rest fall into two kinds you can fix inside your own window, plus one multiplier that isn't about your window at all: fanning out.'), or leave 'two kinds' as scoped only to single-window drivers and say so explicitly at first mention so the reader isn't left to reconcile the count against three headers unaided.
